name: WatchSense
description: TV series recommendations from your own viewing history and an AI model you pick

paths.name: Data
paths.description: The SQLite database (watchsense.db) and secret.key, the key made on first start that encrypts the API keys and logins you save in Settings. Back up both together.

paths.name: Exports
paths.description: Only for the Trakt import: put your Trakt data export in the trakt folder inside it. WatchSense only reads this folder.

ports.name: Web UI
ports.description: WatchSense web app, published on host as 6173

variables.name: TZ
variables.description: Your time zone, like Europe/London or America/New_York.

variables.name: PUID
variables.description: The user id that owns the app's files. 500 is the MOS default.

variables.name: PGID
variables.description: The group id that owns the app's files. 500 is the MOS default.
